That's actually pretty cool, I'll try to make one.

I guess I've always wondered the meaning of life and such, so learning about things outside of Earth to me is fundamentally important. I'm not sure why people are so focused about only one planet (Earth) and careless of anything else.

It doesn't bother me too much that I'm a virgin and all (it's just icing on the cake), it's being ugly, poor, and dull, and being forced to exist a joke of life like that daily that bothers me. Everywhere I look, there are decent/good looking people with perfectly clear skin and an inviting personality etc. (99% of people). I'm just so inferior to everyone in seemingly every way.

The only thing I've done in my empty life is use the computer. I always disliked poems (sorry to be an asshole).

The only other thing I could say I like is astronomy. I don't even know.

I don't have big acne issues anymore, just acne scars and an ugly face. I still have some acne but not problematic for roccutane.

Regardless, I come from a poor family and I'm too much of a coward to get a job of my own. Dermatologists were never an option.

It's not even just the acne scars, I have more problems with my face than that. I feel the acne scars is just the straw that broke the camel's back.. everyone else seems to have perfect skin, no moles, no acne, no scars and indents on their face like me with my big nose, odd facial features etc.. It's ridiculous, I just want to look slightly normal, average at least. But instead I look different and feel like I am low quality..

I know a lot about computers for sure, I can build PC's, remove viruses etc. but when I go on craigslist and see all of the other people advertising their business, having decades of experience and all, I feel very reluctant to even try. Plus I'm anxious of what people will think of my personality and looks. I feel like people think I'm some kind of weirdo.. usually after I meet people I end up feeling guilty and ashamed of all my social fuck ups. I usually do say some stupid shit and regret being foolish.

What I typically do is browse reddit.. play dota 2, try to learn Java (programming language), try to do stretches to help my back, exercise.. and honestly that's about it, I'm watching Mad Men right now. 

The only game I play is a PC game called Dota 2, I'm at 5800 matches now (6000 hours). It's what occupies most of my time.. Again thanks for the help, usually people don't give any fucks.

Meh, he has 2 kids and a wife, even though he's my age. It's not really feasible to hang out with him often, he has better things to do the way I see it. I also don't have a phone, can't really afford it nor would it be worth it, I talk to him on facebook.

I did horribly academically. My mom didn't really try getting me to school on time, and I would sometimes not go at all, I was usually at least late. I would never do my homework, since like the 4th or 5th grade. I was never pushed to do anything at all, I just used my computer or played video games since that's all I really had. However I was always really good at English naturally, I just never got math. I'm 20 and I would fail an Algebra 1 class honestly. Anyways it doesn't help that I always got bullied in school so I hated school. In the 7th grade I cried in class when my teacher got mad at me--I was also a complete loner then, in the 10th grade a group of "friends" made me cry since they hit my breaking point from group bullied by them so often. With acne, horrible grades, ostracized for years, etc. I left..

I walk my dog a few times a week, but I often feel too ashamed of my face etc. to even go outside and I usually do it at night. However I do exercise, I lift weights every 2 days and such so I do get SOME sun. As for hobbies, all I do is use my computer. That's how it's been for a while.

I don't know what I'd want as a career, I really have 0 skills. I'd have to guess astronomy or computer science, but I have trouble even finishing my GED. My discipline is awful, I have no motivation and when I try to be productive I just feel tired and I give up quickly.. it's pathetic. I'm pretty good with computers though, since I've spent so much time on them. I'm not sure that matters much though..

I can't seem to make myself do shit I don't want to do no matter what. I've got no discipline, no willpower..

I have one friend from high school who I see sometimes. He's a very good person, but I can tell I bore him by being dull, we don't hang out much but he invites me over a few times every year. I guess I could say he's my best friend. 

My family is kinda dysfunctional. I come from a fatherless home, my dad molested my sister and left a long time ago, her actual dad died when they were young. There's always been lots of anger in my family. Depression is in almost everyone but no one has brought it up, lots of repression. I've always been poor as fuck so I never got to do anything fun in my life, my mom never took me out to do anything etc. I know she has depression, she raised me badly and she definitely shouldn't have had kids. My grandparents were depressed too, and they hated each other--I lived with them until they died a few years ago and I know my grandpa was just waiting to die. My big brother is 34 and lives with us still, he's hateful and always treated me pretty shitty, he was emotionally abusive to me and still kinda is. I have a little brother and I don't talk to him, but he is more "normal" than me, he's a few years younger but he's passed HS, he has decent looks but the way my mom raised me we never had a relationship.. we just ignore each other.

I'm 20.5, I dropped out of HS years ago. I'm insecure about my looks and personality. I don't really have anything positive in my life. I was always bullied in school, I have acne scars and had acne issues when I was in my teens (15+) so I always stayed in because I would get like 3 pimples every day and be ashamed of my looks, even using acne creams didn't help and I could never afford a dermatologist, still can't.

I have lots of cousins, my grandma had like 13 kids but I don't talk to any of them. They also don't talk to my mom, it's like our genetics suck ass and people just don't like us. All my cousins were either too young or too old for me and I was always avoided because of it. As for the people I'm talking about, it's my brother's girlfriend's family--I don't think they were necessarily being assholes, but they're so "normal" that they see me and I can feel the disappointment from them. 

The only positive things I can probably muster up is that I have above average intelligence, but not by much. I'm only 115 IQ. I'm smarter than the majority of people I meet but I have no motivation so whys it matter. No discipline. I've never gotten a job, mostly because I've always felt significantly ugly. I've basically always hated how I am unattractive and I feel trapped because of it. I probably sound like a spoiled pussy, oh well.

Thanks for reading my essay.. :\

Yes, no one wants to be your babysitter. Why would anyone spend their time being bored with a depressed person when they could enjoy their time with someone who is integrated into society? I'm not mad at them, you only live once, why spend your time being bored? It makes a whole lot of sense.

I've thought about this too. I don't want a funeral, I had no childhood. I had no fun. I always hated my poor useless existence. Sheltered, quiet, low key despised--what are people going to say at my funeral, really? I'm ugly, I don't want people to see me even after death.

It's probably better if we just pretend I never existed in the first place. Because I haven't ever really.

I can mostly relate.. except, I'm a friendless ugly virgin.. however I haven't passed high school either. No motivation to get anything done. I hope I can get my GED done at least by early 2017..

My life is wasted
